newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: KB Bratislava sees '96 profits rising.
newsitem.headline: KB Bratislava sees '96 profits rising.

text.p: Komercni Banka Bratislava a.s., a subsidiary of Czech Komercni Banka a.s., on Friday said it expects 1996 net profit of up to 19 million crowns.

"This compares with an after-tax profit of 707,000 crowns for 1995 when we started our operation in Slovakia," Marian Sedo, chief executive of Komercni Bratislava, said at the opening of its first branch in Slovakia.
The bank's assets rose to 3.1 billion crowns, he added.
Komercni Bratislava opened in September 1995 and offers a full range of products to both business and private clients, whose accounts at the bank reached some 1.2 billion at the end of 1996.
One of its main activities is to provide payment facilities for trade between Slovakia and the Czech Republic. In December it facilitated some 1.5 billion crowns worth of deals.
Over the next two months Komercni Bratislava will open two more branches, one in Kosice, western Slovakia, and one in Banska Bystrica, central Slovakia.
